subject: Liability certificates and additional insured routing — Equinox Order Form
messages:
From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@equinox.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Mark Johnson <mjohnson@equinox.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Equinox order form — COI & addl insured requirements

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for sending the draft order form. Our legal/risk team reviewed it and asked that we confirm insurance evidence and naming for the upcoming engagement. Attached is our COI requirements sheet for OrderForm v3 (Equinox_COI_Reqs_20260615.pdf). Key asks are below — please confirm feasibility and a target delivery date for certificates/endorsements:

- Commercial General Liability: $5M per occurrence / $10M aggregate
- Additional Insured: Equinox Health, Inc. (primary wording preferred; ISO CG 20X forms acceptable)
- Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Equinox for GL & Employers Liability
- Cyber Liability: $3M, include retroactive date to policy inception if possible
- Evidence: COI + endorsement naming, or broker letter confirming pending endorsement and expected issuance date

We need evidence prior to kickoff (target: latest Jun 30). If you need a temporary exception (COI-only with endorsement to follow), let us know what timeframe your broker expects. Also looping in our procurement lead (Mark) for scheduling.

Attachments: Equinox_COI_Reqs_20260615.pdf

Best,
Olivia Harper
Senior Contracts Manager
Equinox Health, Inc.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@equinox.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Equinox order form — COI & addl insured requirements

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear requirements and the timeline. We can work to meet Jun 30 but I want to set expectations on the endorsement turnaround. Quick summary and proposed plan below.

Summary of what we can do now:
- Provide an initial COI naming Equinox Health, Inc. as certificate holder and, where available, include Additional Insured language on the COI. Attached is our internal certificate template we typically send to brokers (Redwood_Certificate_Template_20260617.pdf).
- Endorsement (formal additional insured wording) may take 7–10 business days from the broker/insurer after we submit the request; some carriers require underwriter sign-off.
- Cyber retroactive date: we will ask our broker to confirm whether they can endorse back to policy inception. If not, we will provide the earliest available retro date and a broker-attested explanation.

Proposed mutual action plan:
1) Naomi to ask broker (Aegis) to issue COI + confirm endorsement timing by EOD Jun 18.
2) Kimberly to coordinate any required redline to the Order Form insurance clause and confirm whether the MSA needs an explicit endorsement clause.
3) Laura to collect final insurer contact and update procurement sheet + DocuSign link.
4) If endorsement cannot be provided before Jun 30, Redwood will provide a COI + broker letter confirming endorsement is in process and expected date.

Can you confirm whether Equinox will accept a COI + broker letter as interim evidence? If so we should be fine to proceed with kickoff on your target date.

Thanks — looping in Aegis as well.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Equinox order form — COI & addl insured requirements

Naomi / team — I just pulled our broker contact and a quick note on each ask. I can take point on the Order Form redline + broker follow-up.

Broker contact: Aegis Brokers — support@aegisbrokers.com / (415) 555-0199
What they can typically deliver:
- COI naming a certificate holder and often including Additional Insured note on the COI itself (fast, same-day in many cases).
- Formal endorsement (additional insured endorsement) requires carrier sign-off — generally 5–10 business days depending on carrier.
- Waiver of Subrogation: usually handled via endorsement; some carriers will only include for specific lines — broker will check.
- Cyber: some cyber carriers resist retroactive dates; broker will ask but cannot guarantee.

Action items assigned:
- Kimberly: submit COI/endorsement request to Aegis this afternoon, include Equinox wording from their PDF.
- Dylan: can you confirm if the MSA should have an explicit acceptance of COI + broker letter as interim evidence, or should we commit to endorsement language in the Order Form? We want to avoid adding an impossible warranty in the contract.
- Laura: please prep a short procurement note for Equinox with the DocuSign link and proposed kickoff conditional on receipt of COI/broker letter.

I'll send the broker the Redwood certificate template and ask for a target date.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
